description: NOC Device Health. Row 1: 7 tall device cards + Last update tile, each 3 cols wide and 8 rows tall for readable values. Each device card is a vertical stat panel with 4 reduced sub-metrics (PING / SNMP / MEM / CPU), colored by state. Row 2: Memory and CPU timeseries side-by-side, each 11 rows tall, legends renamed to device names via byFrameRefID displayName overrides. No expression-chained tiles — those were replaced by compact per-device cards which already answer 'who is unhealthy' at a glance. All itemids live-validated via /api/ds/query (28/28).

panels.description: SNMP badge is derived from FRESH data, not the Zabbix availability flag (which stays "unknown" while SNMP works). OK: sysUpTime (SNMP, polled every 30 s) has a sample in the last 2 minutes. DOWN: no fresh SNMP sample while ICMP is still collected (or availability = 2). UNK: Zabbix has no data at all for this router. "—" on PING/MEM/CPU = no sample in the last 2 min. MEM is a calculated Zabbix item, so it is never used as proof of SNMP freshness.
